headline: Italian Banking Stocks Drop on ECB Reserve Requirement Concerns
summary: Shares of Italian lenders including BPER declined in Milan amid fears that the ECB could raise mandatory bank reserve requirements.
why: European Central Bank minimum reserve requirements impact commercial bank liquidity and net interest margins.

impacts.name: FTSE MIB
impacts.why: Weakness in bank constituents dragged down the Italian equity index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding potential ECB reserve rules led to selling across Italian financial equities.
